_comment: Bootstrap datasets for DX-001 (SPEC 3.3: public data for bootstrapping only, tagged source=public). Every entry is pinned to a Hugging Face dataset revision and the LFS sha256 of each file. Nothing here is committed to Git: data/download.py fetches into data/raw/, data/prepare.py writes data/cache/ + data/manifest.csv.

sources.attribution: Sethy P.K. (2024), Rice Leaf Disease Image Samples, Mendeley Data V2, doi:10.17632/fwcj7stb8r.2 (via AgML)
sources.notes: Odisha, India; field leaf close-ups on plain background, 4 diseases, no healthy class.

sources.attribution: Bishshash P. et al. (2024), SAR-CLD-2024 cotton leaf disease dataset, Mendeley Data V2, doi:10.17632/b3jy2p6k8w.2 (via AgML)
sources.notes: Bangladesh field photos; raw config only (the augmented config would leak across splits).

sources.attribution: Aishwarya M.P., Reddy A.P. (2024), chilli dataset, Mendeley Data V2, doi:10.17632/tf9dtfz9m6.2 (via AgML)
sources.notes: Karnataka, India; only 532 raw images, so chilli is the smallest class (class weights compensate).

sources.attribution: Appiah O. et al. (2024), TOM2024, Mendeley Data V1, doi:10.17632/3d4yg89rtr.1 (via AgML)
sources.notes: Burkina Faso field photos of tomato, onion and maize (leaves, fruits, pests); onion is used as a non-pilot 'other' crop. The cap applies per mapped crop.

sources.attribution: Sasmal B. et al. (2024), A novel groundnut leaf dataset, Mendeley Data V2, doi:10.17632/x6x5jkk873.2 (via AgML)
Talasila S. et al. (2022), Blackgram Plant Leaf Disease Dataset, Mendeley Data V3, doi:10.17632/zfcv9fmrgv.3 (via AgML)
sources.notes: Andhra Pradesh, India; a non-pilot pulse crop grown next to the pilot crops, used for 'other'.

sources.attribution: Hailu Y. (2021), Banana Leaf Disease Images, Mendeley Data V1, doi:10.17632/rjykr62kdh.1 (via AgML)
Li F.-F., Andreeto M., Ranzato M., Perona P. (2022), Caltech 101 (1.0), CaltechDATA, doi:10.22002/D1.20086
sources.notes: Non-plant negatives for is_plant; plant-like categories and the unlabelled Google background set are excluded.
Flat colours, gradients, noise, soil-like brown texture, sky, lens-covered black frames: the non-plant frames a field camera actually produces.
